2173-4574-4659-7435--44.description:
Sacrifice the templated artifact.
Resolve the ability of your sacrifice outlet.
Remove a +1/+1 counter from Arcbound Reclaimer, putting the artifact on top of your library.
Your leaves-the-graveyard effect triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Arcbound Reclaimer.
Cast the templated artifact for 0 life through Bolas's Citadel.
Repeat.
2173-4574-4659-7435--44.notes:
This combo will only result in creature ETB/LTB/etc. if the chosen card from the template is an artifact creature, in which case creature-specific sacrifice outlets may also be used.
For artifacts from the template that can sacrifice themselves, the free sacrifice outlet is unnecessary.

1887-4247-5254.easyPrerequisites: You control another creature with power 4 or greater.
1887-4247-5254.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing the creature with power 4 or greater.
When the creature dies, Warbeast of Gorgoroth triggers, creating a 0/0 Army creature token if you don't control one, then putting four +1/+1 counters on an Army you control.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability, giving Bloodthrone Vampire +2/+2 until end of turn
Repeat.

3234-3293-4247-5411.easyPrerequisites: You control a Plains or have a Plains in your graveyard.
3234-3293-4247-5411.description:
Activate Need for Speed by sacrificing a land.
Repeat step 1 until you control no lands.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing World Shaper.
When World Shaper dies, it triggers, return all lands from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter, Emeria Shepherd triggers that many times.
Resolve an Emeria Shepherd trigger that was triggered by a Plains, returning World Shaper from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve all remaining Emeria Shepherd triggers.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat
3234-3293-4247-5411.notes: You can return all nonland permanents in your graveyard and library to the battlefield if you control there are two or more Plains between your graveyard, library and battlefield. To do this, have all triggers from Emeria Shepherd target desired permanents. Then, resolve the Plains triggers first to return those cards to the battlefield, causing all other triggers to fizzle on the stack.

1981-2415-2511-6273.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Embalmed Ascendant and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Embalmed Ascendant trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

23-1651-1781-7839.description:
Cause Orcish Vandal to become an artifact using Thran Forge.
Activate Orcish Vandal by tapping it, dealing 2 damage to Smaug.
Smaug triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the Treasures, untapping Orcish Vandal.
Repeat from step 2.

670-1619-3742-6153.notablePrerequisites: You are currently venturing in Tomb of Annihilation in the Trapped Entry room.
670-1619-3742-6153.description:
Cast Phantom Steed by paying its mana cost.
When Phantom Steed enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Phantom Steed trigger, exiling Vicious Battlerager until Phantom Steed leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Phantom Steed.
Phantom Steed leaves the battlefield, causing Vicious Battlerager to be returned to the battlefield from exile.
When Vicious Battlerager enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Vicious Battlerager trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Phantom Steed from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Phantom Steed enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Phantom Steed trigger, exiling Vicious Battlerager until Phantom Steed leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 10, venturing into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 6, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Phantom Steed.
Repeat from step 5.

4149-4599-4871-6019-6965.description:
Activate Ghoulcaller Gisa by paying {B}, tapping it and sacrificing Scourge of Nel Toth.
When Scourge of Nel Toth dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Ghoulcaller Gisa ability, creating six 2/2 Zombie creature tokens.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Scourge of Nel Toth from your graveyard by paying {B}{B} and sacrificing a Zombie token and Ghoulcaller Gisa.
When the Zombie and Ghoulcaller Gisa die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve Scourge of Nel Toth.
Activate Gravespawn Sovereign by tapping Scourge of Nel Toth and four other Zombies, returning Ghoulcaller GIsa from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

4120-4186-5686-7352.notablePrerequisites: Vigor has indestructible, protection from creatures or protection from red.
4120-4186-5686-7352.description:
Cast Electric Seaweed by paying {2}{R}{R}.
When Electric Seaweed enters, it triggers.
Activate Electric Seaweed by tapping it, attempting to deal 1 damage to Scurry Oak, which will instead put a +1/+1 counter on it due to Vigor.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Electric Seaweed triggers, dealing 1 damage to each non-Wall creature your opponents control. Each non-Wall creature you control (excluding Vigor) will not be dealt damage, and will instead have a +1/+1 counter put on it due to Vigor.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat from step 5.

240-4050-5470-7296.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing an Egg token, adding one mana of any color
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: is paired with The Third Doctor

1409-1418-5422.description:
Activate The Third Doctor by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When The Third Doctor enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger twice.
Resolve both Deadeye Navigator triggers, repairing it and The Third Doctor.
Resolve both The Third Doctor triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with Mirror Room locked and Fractured Realm unlocked

3457-5921-5970-6965.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of Seeker of Skybreak.
Activate one of the Seeker of Skybreak tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other Seeker of Skybreak token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

628-5670-5708--5.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
628-5670-5708--5.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers if it didn't have a -1/-1 counter on it, and its undying ability triggers if it didn't have a +1/+1 counter on it. Vein Ripper also triggers regardless.
Resolve the Vein Ripper trigger, causing target opponent to lose 2 life and you to gain 2 life.
Resolve the persist trigger, if applicable, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the undying trigger, if applicable, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Repeat

uses.n: The Legend of Kuruk // Avatar Kuruk

1446-2963-7009.manaNeeded: {3}{U} plus {20} minus {1} for each creature and artifact you control each turn available
1446-2963-7009.description:
Activate Avatar Kuruk by paying {20} minus {1} for each creature and/or artifact you can tap while activating it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Teleportation Circle triggers, blinking Avatar Kuruk and causing it to return to the battlefield as The Legend of Kuruk with a lore counter on it.
The Legend of Kuruk's first chapter ability triggers, causing you to scry 2 and draw a card.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your precombat main phase. The Legend of Kuruk triggers, putting a lore counter on it. Its second chapter ability then triggers, causing you to scry 2 and draw a card.
Activate Viral Drake by paying {3}{U}, causing you to proliferate and put a lore counter on The Legend of Kuruk.
The Legend of Kuruk's third chapter ability triggers, causing you to exile it and return it to the battlefield as Avatar Kuruk.
Repeat.

1978-5143-6478.notablePrerequisites: You control another creature with toughness 3 or greater.
1978-5143-6478.description:
Activate Arbor Adherent by tapping it, adding at least {3}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Arbor Adherent.
Repeat

4264-4608-5466.easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Altered Ego.
4264-4608-5466.notablePrerequisites: You control five or more enchantments.
4264-4608-5466.description:
Cast Altered Ego by paying its mana cost. Choose to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Rakdos Joins Up.
Put Altered Ego into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Altered Ego's first ability and second ability trigger, along with Rakdos Joins Up's second ability.
Resolve Altered Ego's second trigger and Rakdos Joins Up's trigger, dealing damage to target opponent.
Resolve Altered Ego's first trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with two +1/+1 counters on it as a copy of Rakdos Joins Up.
Repeat from step 2.

1580-2060-6701-6797.description:
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton is sacrificed, Szarel triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters equal to Szarel's power on Crystalline Crawler.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Activate Crystalline Crawler twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{B}.
Repeat.
1580-2060-6701-6797.notes: This combo can put infinite +1/+1 counters on each creature you control except Szarel so long as its power is greater than the mana needed to activate the creature's ability from your graveyard.

586-5626-5687-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Skittering Precursor triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}{E}{E}, sacrificing the Eldrazi Spawn and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning Priest of Gix from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Repeat.

2225-3767-3918-4306.easyPrerequisites: Trazyn the Infinite does not have summoning sickness.
2225-3767-3918-4306.notablePrerequisites: Your devotion to any color is at least 3.
2225-3767-3918-4306.description:
Activate Trazyn using Nyx Lotus's ability by tapping it, adding at least three mana of any color with which you have devotion.
Activate Trazyn by paying {2}, untapping it.
Repeat.

24-1815.description:
Cast Wheel of Misfortune by paying {2}{R}.
Holding priority, cast Samite Ministration by paying {1}{W}, preventing all damage dealt by Wheel of Misfortune to you, and causing you to gain that much life.
Resolve Wheel of Misfortune, choosing an arbitrarily large number, and causing you to gain life equal to the number you chose if you chose the largest number.
If you didn't choose the largest number, Wheel of Misfortune deals that much damage to each opponent who chose the largest number.

1978-2585-3007.easyPrerequisites: You have a card in hand.
1978-2585-3007.description:
Animate Grim Monolith using Toymaker.
Activate Grim Monolith by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Grim Monolith.
Repeat from step 2.

240-4486-4825.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to increase only Atla Palani's toughness by at least one.
240-4486-4825.description:
Increase Atla's toughness by at least one.
Activate Mirror Entity an arbitrarily large number of times by paying a total of {0}.
Resolve the first Mirror Entity ability, causing all creatures you control to have base power and toughness 0/0 and gain all creature types until end of turn.
All creatures you control except Atla die as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
If Emrakul died this way, it triggers, shuffling your graveyard into your library.
Atla triggers once for each creature that died.
Resolve the first Atla trigger, revealing cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card, then putting the creature card onto the battlefield and all other revealed cards on the bottom of your library.
Repeat step 7 for each remaining Atla trigger.
Repeat from step 3 for each remaining Mirror Entity ability.

2882-3788-4675-4694.notablePrerequisites: Infinite Reflection attached to Cavalier of Dawn.
2882-3788-4675-4694.description:
Cast Mox Sapphire by paying {0}.
Mox Sapphire enters the battlefield as a copy of Cavalier of Dawn.
Copy of Cavalier of Dawn enter-the-battlefield ability triggers, destroying itself and creating you a 3/3 Golem token.
Copy of Cavalier of Dawn dies, triggering itself, returning Mox Sapphire from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight
